simple.meaning: צֹר (Tsôr) appears 42 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows צֹר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.full: H6865. Tsor I. צוֺר צֹר, proper name, of a location Τυρος : Tyre , famous Phoenician city (Phoenician צר ; Assyrian ‚urru , so Tel Amarna; Egyptian Da-(ï)ra, Da-ru WMM As.u.Eur.185 ); — צֹר 2Sam 24:7 32t., צוֺר 1Kin 5:15 8 t. (Gi); — city of Hiram, friend of David and Solomon 2Sam 5:11 ; 1Kin 5:15 ; 9:11-12 , 1Chr 14:1 ; 2Chr 2:2 ; 2:10 ; of artif. Hiram 1Kin 7:13 ; בַּתצֹֿר Psa 45:13 of city personified (another view in Che); ׳צ also in name of Phoenician fotress, ׳מִבְצַרצֿ 2Sam 24:7 , מ ׳עִיר ׳צ Josh 19:29 (P); threatened by prophets Amos 1:9-10 , and (with especially reference to commercial greatness) Isa 23:1 ( צֹר מַשָׂא ), 23:5 ; 23:8 ; 23:15 ; 23:15 ; 23:17 ; Jer 25:22 ( מַלְכֵיצֹֿר ), 27:3 ( צֹר מֶלֶךְ ), 47:4 ; Ezek 26:2-3 , 4 , 7 , 15 ; 27:2-3 ,(twice in verse); 27:8 , 32 ; 28:2 ( צֹר נְגִיד ), 28:12 ( צוֺר מֶלֶךְ ); besieged by Nebuch. 29:18 (twice in verse); compare Zech 9:2-3 , Joel 4:4; Psa 83:8 ( צ ׳ישְׁבֵי ); of Tyrians as proselytes 87:4 (predict.); — לְצוֺר Hosea 9:13 is probably corrupt, read לָצוֺד or ᵐ5 לָצַיִד We GASm, compare Now. — ׳צ often + צִידוֺן q. v.; — see, on Tyre, Pietschm Phön. 60 ff. Rob BR ii. 461 ff. de Luynes Voyage à la Mer Morte (1874) i. 28 ff. , and Pl xiii-xviii Bd Pal. 3 (1898), 307 ff : —
